exploratory_gene_reversion.scope: Development TRAIN mechanism study motivated by the completed repeat0 CMA training result. It is not a final efficacy endpoint or optimizer-superiority test and cannot change any nominee, selection, final panel or primary analysis.

gene_mapping.genes_0_to_8: Signed linear coefficients for feature columns1 through9
gene_mapping.gene_9: Log coefficient for direct_goal_latent; runtime exponentiates it

exploratory_gene_reversion.fresh_seed_rule: 623000 + original source_episode, common to all12 arms
exploratory_gene_reversion.order: Original8-case order; all12 arms per case, cyclic offset by case index
exploratory_gene_reversion.execution_condition: Root may launch only after main secondaryR0 selection if a safe pre-final waiting window leaves at least8minutes before the joint-final critical path. Otherwise retain this protocol clearly unexecuted. This builder launches nothing.
